TextTheorem: "If $f$ has a pole of order $m$ at $z_0$, then
              $\operatorname{Res}(f,z_0)=\frac{1}{(m-1)!}
              \lim_{z\to z_0}\frac{d^{m-1}}{dz^{m-1}}
              ((z-z_0)^m f(z))$. For a simple pole represented as $f=g/h$ with
              $h(z_0)=0$ and $h'(z_0)\ne0$, this reduces to
              $\operatorname{Res}(f,z_0)=g(z_0)/h'(z_0)$."
Id: "324cfa4b-56db-4bab-804d-721de64b087e"
